howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可查询该技能内置的命令手册资料，针对 git-log、git-diff、curl 等命令给出语法、选项、示例及关联命令。
howto.when: 当用户需要测试 golden man build，或想了解其中命令（如 git-log、curl）的语法、选项或示例时触发。

say.text: git log 有哪些常用选项？
say.note: Claude 会从技能手册中列出 git-log 的选项。

say.text: curl 的 -s 参数是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会查找 curl 手册并解释该参数。

say.text: 给我一个 git diff 的用法示例
say.note: Claude 会引用技能中的示例并说明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can look up command manual data in this skill, providing syntax, options, examples, and related commands for tools like git-log, git-diff, and curl.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to test the golden man build, or wants to know syntax, options, or examples of commands such as git-log or curl.

say_en.text: What common options does git log have?
say_en.note: Claude lists git-log options from the skill.
Claude looks up the curl manual and explains it.

say_en.text: Give me an example of git diff usage
say_en.note: Claude cites an example from the skill.
